operating_notes.text: Approved ₹3,726 crore capex for 6 GW wafer and ingot facility at Gangaikondan by FY29.
FY27 non-DCR volume expected to deliver EBITDA of ₹1.75 to ₹2 per watt peak on average.
Secured a 187 MW order for N-Type TOPCon G12R modules (615–625 Wp, glass-to-glass bifacial) for projects at three locations in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
The order is one-time and domestic, with execution to be completed by December 2026; the customer is a leading renewable energy developer already associated with the company.
The filing discloses order size only in MW; no rupee consideration is stated.
9-GW N-type TOPCon solar cell plant at Gangaikondan, Tamil Nadu, on track for first cells in December 2026; facility developed via wholly owned subsidiary VSL Green Power Private Limited.
Secured a 289.87 MWp order for N-Type TOPCon G12R modules from NLC India Limited for the RUVN Solar Park in Rajasthan.
The order is to be executed by March 2027.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,452.82 Cr, net profit ₹110.42 Cr.
Vikram Solar submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹530.92 Cr utilized out of ₹1,500 Cr IPO proceeds.
Vikram Solar Limited held an earnings conference call on May 08, 2026, at 10:00 AM (IST) to discuss Q4 FY26 and FY26 financial performance.
Vikram Solar reported Q4 and FY26 earnings, guiding for FY27 EBITDA of ₹1,500-1,600 Cr on 7.5-8 GW production and announcing a ₹3,700 Cr wafer-ingot capex.

Vikram Capital Management Private Limited, on behalf of Vikram Solar Limited’s promoters and persons acting in concert, declared no encumbrance on VSL shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
15 Oct 2026: Vikram Solar disclosed a 187 MW N-Type TOPCon G12R module supply order from a leading Indian renewable developer, to be executed by December 2026.
Vikram Solar confirmed its 9-GW TOPCon solar cell plant in Gangaikondan is on schedule for first cell output in December 2026.
Vikram Solar secured a 289.87 MWp N-Type TOPCon module supply order from NLC India for a solar project in Rajasthan, to be completed by March 2027.
